entries.title: Numbers 29:11
segments: Beside the sin-offering of atonement; that is, besides the special sin-offerings appointed for this day, which was the great day of atonement.  See

. 
 
The frequency with which the atonement of Christ is brought to view, in both the Old Testament and the New shows its importance in the system of mercy which God has devised for the salvation of men, and the necessity of relying upon it in order to obtain pardon and eternal life.

entries.title: Numbers 29:39
segments: True love to God will lead men not only to attend habitually and conscientiously on the appointed means of grace, but cheerfully to present to him freewill offerings of prayer, alms, thanksgiving, and praise.
